english.quote: A band score of 6.5 or better; individual component scores of 6.0 or better.
english.notes: IELTS Academic. TOEFL for Science: 90 (120-point scale, tests up to January 20, 2026) or 4.5 (6-point scale, tests as of January 21, 2026), minimum components 21 each (or 4.5). Duolingo 'Score of 125 or better'. Exempt after at least four years of school in a country where English is the primary language. 'score minima can change at any time'.

value.description: Equivalent of a B+ average on the high school record (university-wide minimum for 'Other international high schools'); most programs higher

gpa.quote: While the minimum requirements is the equivalent of a B+ average, most programs will have higher requirements.
gpa.notes: Letter-grade equivalent, no numeric scale; 'Applicants are reviewed on their high school transcript with particular emphasis on yearly averages and results in prerequisite subjects'. Curriculum-specific pages exist (A-level, IB, HKDSE, etc.). If the converter treats 'equivalent of a B+' as prose, downgrade to unknown.

deadline.quote: Deadlines for admission DEADLINES Application for admission January 15
deadline.notes: Page 'Other international high schools'. Year not printed; applications open October 1 for Fall 2027. Major Entrance Scholarship application & documents: January 21. No timezone printed.

value.name: McGill Entrance Scholarship Program (one-year $3,000; Major Entrance Scholarships $3,000-$12,000 renewable)

scholarship_exists.quote: McGill's Scholarships and Student Aid offers merit-based entrance scholarships to first-time university students entering a full-time undergraduate degree program.
scholarship_exists.notes: Merit-based, competitive ('even if you meet the minimum requirements, you are not guaranteed an offer'). Major Entrance Scholarships by selection committee; separate application by January 21. Amounts in CAD.

scholarship_international.quote: Newly admitted undergraduate students can apply to McGill’s Entrance Scholarship Program.
scholarship_international.notes: On the 'International students' page of Scholarships and Student Aid. Exception: '$12,000 scholarships are only available to Canadian citizens or legal permanent residents of Canada.' Need-based aid also for 'undergraduates from Canada, US, and abroad'.
